maddeler.e:
نرباث (form XI)
# نَرْبَاثُّ (narbāṯṯu) /nar.baːθ.θu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْبَاثَّ (irbāṯṯa)
# نَرْبَاثَّ (narbāṯṯa) /nar.baːθ.θa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْبَاثَّ (irbāṯṯa)
# نَرْبَاثِّ (narbāṯṯi) /nar.baːθ.θi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْبَاثَّ (irbāṯṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
